backend/main.mo: Defines actor with storage and authorization mixins plus extensive social-media-related types for posts, profiles, groups, polls, messaging, reporting, and analytics.
feature_evidence.json: Lists implemented features with related files, components, test IDs, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains human‑written summaries for numerous frontend files describing their roles and functionality.
frontend/ANDROID_BRANDING_ASSETS.md: Documents Android branding assets and how icons and splash images are generated for the Capacitor build.
frontend/ANDROID_PLAY_STORE_BUILD.md: Guide for building and signing an Android App Bundle for Play Store submission.
frontend/android/.gitignore: Gitignore rules for Android project directories, build outputs, and sensitive files like keystores.
frontend/android/keystore/README.md: Explains Android keystore purpose and warns not to commit real signing keys.
frontend/capacitor.config.ts: Capacitor configuration defining app metadata, navigation allowances, Android settings, and splash screen options.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles and OKLCH color variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML document loading the CivWorld root element and main script.
frontend/scripts/android-build.sh: Shell script to build the web app, sync Capacitor, and produce Android debug or release builds.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up the main React app layout, routing, and Internet Identity initialization with Capacitor support.
Implements a shim to reroute Internet Identity window.open calls through the Capacitor Browser plugin.
frontend/src/capacitor/README.md: Provides build instructions and prerequisites for running the app on Android via Capacitor.
frontend/src/capacitor/runtime.ts: Contains platform detection utilities for determining Capacitor, Android, and iOS environments.
frontend/src/capacitor/TROUBLESHOOTING_I: Offers guidance for diagnosing Internet Identity issues on Android builds.
frontend/src/components/AnalyticsDashboa: Displays analytics metrics and top posts using data from useGetAnalyticsData.
frontend/src/components/BadgeDisplay.tsx: Renders user badges with icons and tooltips, supporting size limits and overflow count.
frontend/src/components/BottomNav.tsx: Provides a fixed bottom navigation bar with route-aware highlighting and mixed icon types.
frontend/src/components/ChatWindow.tsx: Implements a messaging UI showing conversation history, user info, and message sending functionality.
frontend/src/components/CreateDiscussion: Modal for creating discussions with fields for title, context, region, and category, using a mutation to submit and reset state on success.
frontend/src/components/CreateGroupModal: Modal for creating a group with name, description, and optional cover image upload, including progress tracking and form reset.
frontend/src/components/CreateGroupPostM: Modal for creating group posts with text and optional image upload, supporting previews and upload progress.
frontend/src/components/CreatePollCard.t: Empty or placeholder component file with no implementation.
frontend/src/components/CreatePostCard.t: Component for creating general posts with text, image, or video, including validation, previews, and upload progress handling.
frontend/src/components/EditPostModal.ts: Modal for editing existing posts with text, image, and video updates, handling previews, validation, and upload processing.
frontend/src/components/EditProfileModal: Modal for editing user profile fields (name, bio, location) and saving changes via profile API hooks.
frontend/src/components/EditProfilePictu: Modal for uploading, previewing, validating, processing, and saving or removing a user's profile photo with upload progress support.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: App header with authentication controls, navigation shortcuts, and a notifications popover with unread-count handling.
frontend/src/components/HorizontalNav.ts: Horizontal navigation bar rendering tabs for discussions, polls, and constituency views with active-state styling.
frontend/src/components/PollCard.tsx: Empty placeholder component for poll card UI.
frontend/src/components/PostCard.tsx: Rich post UI supporting likes, comments, deletion, editing, reporting, timestamps, and author profile display.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Initial profile creation modal collecting name, bio, and location and saving a new user profile.
frontend/src/components/QuickPostBar.tsx: UI component for creating posts with text, image, or video uploads, including validation and submission via useCreatePost.
frontend/src/components/ReportModal.tsx: Modal for submitting content reports with reason selection, details, and backend submission handling.
Displays trending hashtags with loading shimmer and navigation or callback handling on hashtag selection.
frontend/src/components/VerifiedBadge.ts: Renders a verified badge icon with a tooltip and optional size customization.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and manages the backend actor based on Internet Identity, refetching dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and hooks for managing Internet Identity authentication, login state, and identity persistence.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for fetching and mutating posts, profiles, reports, and other backend data using the actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers and extensive CSS variables for light/dark themes plus global interaction and touch behavior rules.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers and mounts the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/CreatePagePage.tsx: Form UI for creating a new user page with image uploads, validation, and a temporary simulated submit action.
frontend/src/pages/CreatePollPage.tsx: Interactive poll creation form with option management, validation, authentication checks, and poll submission.
frontend/src/pages/DiscussionsPage.tsx: Displays discussion posts with a post creation card and loading/empty states using fetched post data.
frontend/src/pages/EventsPage.tsx: Static page presenting a 'Coming Soon' events feature with descriptive cards and a create-event button.
frontend/src/pages/ExplorePage.tsx: Explore view showing trending posts, active groups, and analytics with tabbed navigation and computed rankings.
frontend/src/pages/GroupDetailPage.tsx: Displays a group's details, members, posts, and allows joining and creating posts if the user is a member.
frontend/src/pages/GroupsPage.tsx: Lists all groups and the user's groups with tabs, and provides modals to create new groups.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Renders public and news feed posts with filtering, sorting, and admin/verified news-post creation dialog.
frontend/src/pages/MessagesPage.tsx: Allows starting a conversation by entering a Principal ID and displays a chat window once selected.
frontend/src/pages/MyAreaPage.tsx: Empty page placeholder with no implemented content.
frontend/src/pages/MyConstituencyPage.ts: Lets users submit local issues with optional images and view issues and political promises by status.
frontend/src/pages/PagesPage.tsx: Placeholder page showing upcoming pages feature with navigation to create a new page.
frontend/src/pages/PollsPage.tsx: Renders a polls feed with filters, voting logic, and mock category/region metadata.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Displays the logged‑in user's profile, posts, badges, and edit options with modals.
frontend/src/pages/ProfileView.tsx: Empty placeholder file with no implemented content.
frontend/src/pages/SharePage.tsx: Provides UI for creating posts and shows placeholder sections for events and video uploads.
frontend/src/pages/TopicPage.tsx: Shows posts matching a hashtag and allows navigating back or starting a discussion.
frontend/src/pages/UserProfilePage.tsx: Displays another user's profile with follow, message, report options, and their posts.
frontend/src/pages/VideoPage.tsx: Placeholder page indicating video feed functionality is coming soon.
frontend/src/types/index.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces and enums for posts, profiles, polls, messaging, groups, notifications, analytics, discussions, reports, and education types.
frontend/src/utils/backendErrors.ts: Provides functions to convert backend errors into user-friendly messages and detect authentication or system-readiness issues.
frontend/src/utils/candidOption.ts: Handles Candid optional serialization and validation for media content, ensuring fields normalize to null and contain valid text or media.
frontend/src/utils/profilePhotoValidatio: Validates image type/size for profile photos and processes them by cropping, compressing, and generating preview data.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading, storing, and clearing URL parameters with session persistence and hash‑based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind theme extensions, colors, animations, and plugins including typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Defines project state and requirements for a standalone Pages module, including navigation, creation flow, permissions, and backend structures.
